beats.care: Heading home from office in East Delhi? Leave early, take the Metro or pick another route.
beats.what: Diversions hit NH-24, Vikas Marg and Road Nos. 56, 57 and 57A from 5 pm to 8 pm on Tuesday.
beats.why: Police expect heavy crowds and vehicles at Ravan-burning and Ramlila events across the city.

cards.body: NH-24, Vikas Marg, Road No. 56, Road No. 57 and Road No. 57A. Police say diversions apply 'as required'.
cards.title: Roads to skip, 5–8 pm

cards.body: DCP West Hareshwar V Swami also counted 16 Durga Puja sites. Junctions near Delhi Gate and Hanuman Mandir have full police deployment.
